title: Paramapadha Sopanam
overview: Sarpanch, VRO, and medical officer-begin to meet brutal ends, each shrouded in secrecy.Police investigation reveals thirty fingerprints on bodies of deceased, but only one fingerprint is found on the last victim, creating a complex puzzle.
